description_en: Queries the mapping configuration of a specified endpoint group that is associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations接口查询指定的终端节点组映射信息配置（自定义路由类型监听）
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-custom-routing-endpoint-group-destinations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --destination-id dst-123abc0000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1j184jhb9i9ubwf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group mapping configuration
parameters.help_zh: 指定需要查询的终端节点组映射信息配置ID
parameters.name: destination_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.help_zh: 映射信息配置所属终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id
